content.text:
None of the groups on this MCP server can rotate an account API token. The groups cover Turnstile, Durable Objects, Email Sending/Routing, Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues and Containers, and none of them includes the account API tokens endpoints.

I listed the groups to look for one that handles account API tokens and didn't find one. I made no API calls and changed nothing, so you'll need to roll the token another way, such as the dashboard or the API tokens endpoint, then update the pipeline's secret.
